shows.name: What's News
shows.cadence: Twice a day, every weekday morning and afternoon
shows.blurb: WSJ's flagship news brief: the top business and market stories in about 10-15 minutes, twice a day. The easiest daily habit of the five.

shows.name: Bloomberg Surveillance
shows.blurb: Tom Keene, Paul Sweeney, Lisa Abramowicz and Jonathan Ferro with the morning's markets conversation and big interviews. Longer-form: good for a walk to campus.

shows.name: Thoughts on the Market
shows.blurb: Short, sharp takes (about 10 minutes) from Morgan Stanley strategists and economists on what moved markets. Perfect between classes.

shows.name: Making Sense
shows.blurb: J.P. Morgan leaders on market trends and the forces shaping the global economy, from the Commercial & Investment Bank's research side.

shows.name: The Markets
shows.blurb: Goldman traders and investors break down one market dynamic at a time, in ten minutes or less. Trading-floor perspective you won't get from the news.
